texto.titulo: A long friendship / Uma longa amizade
texto.ru: I have known Carla for fifteen years. We have been friends since we were at school. She has lived in Lisbon since 2018, and I have lived in São Paulo for ten years. We have not seen each other for two years, but we have talked every week. She has worked for the same company since 2020. How long have I wanted to visit her? For a long time!
texto.pt: Conheço a Carla há quinze anos. Somos amigas desde a época da escola. Ela mora em Lisboa desde 2018 e eu moro em São Paulo há dez anos. Não nos vemos há dois anos, mas conversamos toda semana. Ela trabalha na mesma empresa desde 2020. Há quanto tempo quero visitá-la? Há muito tempo!

perguntas.pergunta: How long has the writer known Carla?
